messages.content: 你能使用lawsuit_search功能從加州的聖塔克拉拉檢索所有涉及實體“Google”的訴訟，然後再從加州的聖馬刁檢索涉及實體“Facebook”的訴訟嗎？

function.name: lawsuit_search
function.description: Retrieve all lawsuits involving a particular entity from specified jurisdiction. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

county.description: The jurisdiction for the lawsuit search.

state.description: The state for the lawsuit search. Default is California.

message.reasoning:

The user says "from 加州的聖塔克拉拉檢索所有涉及實體“Google”的訴訟" and then "再從加州的聖馬刁檢索涉及實體“Facebook”的訴訟". So we need to call the function twice.

We should do it in order: first call for Google in Santa Clara County, then call for Facebook in San Mateo County. The user didn't specify any other parameters. The default state is California, so we can omit state. We need to provide county names exactly as "Santa Clara" and "San Mateo". The entity names are "Google" and "Facebook".

We need to produce two function calls. According to policy, we should not combine them into one call. We should do them sequentially. The user wants us to retrieve all lawsuits. So we will call the function twice.

We should not add any additional text besides the function calls. The user didn't ask for anything else. So we just produce the function calls.
